socfpga_uart_ll.h

UART low-level driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Constants
UART interrupt identification status codes

Values from the interrupt identification register.  Each one names the highest-priority interrupt that is waiting.

MODEM_STATUS

Modem status. The driver reports this as a hardware error.

NO_INTERRUPT

No interrupt is waiting.

THR_EMPTY

The transmit holding register is empty.

RX_DATA_RDY

Receive data is ready.

RX_LINE_STATUS

Receive line status. The driver reports this as a hardware error.

BUSY_DETECT

Busy-detect interrupt. The driver reports this as a hardware error.

CHAR_TIMEOUT

A character timed out. The driver treats this as receive data ready.

Interrupt priority mapping

IDs that get_int_status returns.

UART_NO_INT

No interrupt is waiting.

UART_TXBUF_EMPTY_INT

The transmit buffer can take more data.

UART_RXBUF_RDY_INT

Receive data is ready, or a character timed out.

UART_HW_ERR_INT

Any other identification code, including line errors, modem status, and busy detect.

UART configuration status codes

Values that uart_set_baud returns.

UART_CFG_STATUS_FAIL

The baud rate is 0, so the call failed.

UART_CFG_STATUS_OK

The baud divisor was written.

Types
uart_interrupt_id_t

Maps hardware-specific interrupt events to categorical identifiers used throughout the software stack.

Values
INTERRUPT_RX

Triggered when the RX FIFO reaches the threshold or a character timeout occurs.

INTERRUPT_TX

Triggered when the TX FIFO is empty and ready for more data.

INTERRUPT_HW

Triggered by hardware line errors (parity, framing, break, or overrun).

uart_enable_clock
void uart_enable_clock(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Interfaces with the System Manager to enable the clock gate for the specified UART instance. This must be invoked before any MMIO register access to avoid bus errors or reading stale register states.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index (e.g., 0 for UART0, 1 for UART1).

Returns

None.

uart_disable_clock
void uart_disable_clock(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Interfaces with the System Manager to gate off the clock for the specified UART instance. This reduces dynamic power consumption when the peripheral is no longer in use.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index.

Returns

None.

uart_assert_reset
void uart_assert_reset(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Triggers a hardware reset for the specified UART instance by writing to the Reset Manager. This forces the UART register map and internal state machines back to their power-on default state.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index.

Returns

None.

uart_deassert_reset
void uart_deassert_reset(
uint32_t 
instance
)

Releases the reset signal in the Reset Manager for the specified UART instance, allowing the 16550 controller to begin normal operation and accept MMIO writes.

Parameters
instance
uint32_t

The hardware instance index.

Returns

None.

uart_write_fifo
uint16_t uart_write_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint8_t *const 
buffer,
uint32_t 
bytes
)

Pushes raw byte data into the UART's Transmit Holding Register (THR) FIFO.  This function handles the low-level MMIO loop required to move user data from the memory buffer directly into the UART peripheral for serialization.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

buffer
uint8_t* const

Pointer to the source data buffer.

bytes
uint32_t

The maximum number of bytes to attempt to write.

Returns

The exact number of bytes successfully accepted by the hardware FIFO.

uart_read_fifo
uint16_t uart_read_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint8_t *const 
buffer,
uint32_t 
bytes
)

Extracts available bytes from the UART's Receive Buffer Register (RBR) FIFO.  This function quickly drains the hardware RX FIFO into the provided software memory buffer.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

buffer
uint8_t* const

Pointer to the destination data buffer.

bytes
uint32_t

The maximum number of bytes to attempt to read.

Returns

The exact number of bytes successfully retrieved from the hardware FIFO.

void uart_enable_interrupt(
uint32_t 
base_address,

id
)

Configures the Interrupt Enable Register (IER) to allow specific UART events (such as RX Data Available, TX Holding Register Empty, or Line Status Errors) to actively assert the hardware interrupt line to the processor.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

id
uart_interrupt_id_t

The categorized interrupt event to enable.

Returns

None.

uart_disable_interrupt
void uart_disable_interrupt(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uart_interrupt_id_t 
id
)

Modifies the Interrupt Enable Register (IER) to mask the specific UART event, preventing it from firing an IRQ to the processor while preserving other enabled interrupts.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

id
uart_interrupt_id_t

The categorized interrupt event to disable.

Returns

None.

get_int_status
uint32_t get_int_status(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Reads the Interrupt Identification Register (IIR). This register prioritizes pending interrupts. It is heavily utilized by the ISR to determine exactly why the UART hardware triggered an IRQ (e.g., distinguishing between a character timeout and a full RX FIFO).

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

Returns

The pending interrupt status code directly from the hardware.

void uart_config_fifo(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Writes to the FIFO Control Register (FCR) to explicitly enable the 16550-style TX and RX hardware FIFOs, clear their current contents, and configure the DMA/interrupt watermark trigger levels.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

Returns

None.

uart_set_config
void uart_set_config(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uart_partity_t 
parity,
uart_stop_bits_t 
stopbit,
uint32_t 
wordlen
)

Configures the Line Control Register (LCR). This defines the foundational framing format for asynchronous serial communication: parity mode, number of stop bits, and the word length (bits per character).

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

parity
uart_partity_t

The desired parity configuration (None, Odd, Even).

stopbit
uart_stop_bits_t

The desired number of stop bits (1 or 2).

wordlen
uint32_t

The word length in bits (typically 5 to 8).

Returns

None.

uart_set_baud
uint32_t uart_set_baud(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
baud
)

Sets the UART communication speed. This sequence requires setting the Divisor Latch Access Bit (DLAB) in the LCR, calculating the baud rate divisor against the reference clock, programming the High and Low Divisor Latches (DLH/DLL), and clearing the DLAB to restore standard read/write access to the FIFOs.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

baud
uint32_t

The target baud rate (e.g., 115200, 9600).

Returns

UART_CFG_STATUS_OK when divisor programming succeeds, UART_CFG_STATUS_FAIL when the requested baud is invalid.

uart_get_baud
uint32_t uart_get_baud(
uint32_t 
base_address
)

Calculates the currently active baud rate. It asserts the DLAB bit, reads the Divisor Latch registers (DLL and DLH), and applies the reverse clock division formula against the hardware reference clock.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target UART hardware block.

Returns

The currently active baud rate.
